subject: Multi-region technical deep dive — scheduling proposal
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Ari Matthews <ari.matthews@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Multi-region technical deep dive — scheduling proposal

Hi Ari —

Great to speak earlier. Quick recap: you and the dev lead are interested in a 60-minute technical deep dive covering our private deployment options (VPC + KMS), throughput profiles for bursty inference, and the integration checklist for your HIPAA workflows. You asked for a session that includes your infra and security leads so we can run through the deployment architecture and sample configs.

To keep calendar friction low across US/EU/APAC, we sketched a simple approach: propose three repeating time bands on a rotating weekly cadence so each region sees one friendly local time each month. I've attached a one-sheet grid with UTC conversions and an initial mutual action plan. Can you scan the grid and call out any hard constraints?

Proposed slots (all 60 min):
- Option A (early US / late EU): Tue 17:00 UTC / Tue 13:00 ET / Wed 02:00 SGT
- Option B (EU friendly): Wed 15:00 UTC / Wed 11:00 ET / Thu 00:00 SGT
- Option C (APAC friendly): Thu 06:00 UTC / Wed 02:00 ET / Thu 14:00 SGT

Agenda (60 min):
1) 10m quick intro & goals
2) 25m infra/deployment walkthrough (VPC, KMS, network egress)
3) 15m performance profile & cost levers (batching / quantization)
4) 10m next steps & action items

If any of those windows are a hard no for your team, tell us which days/times to avoid and whether mornings or afternoons are generally preferred in your EU/APAC offices. If you prefer, here's a one-click calendar link: https://calendly.com/redwood-sales/technical-deep-dive

Thanks — I’ll loop Vivek for the engineering details once we lock a slot.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: multi-region-schedule-grid.xlsx, mutual_action_plan.docx

From: Ari Matthews <ari.matthews@solsticehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: dev-team@solsticehealth.com
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:42:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Multi-region technical deep dive — scheduling proposal

Camila — thanks for the recap and the clear agenda. A couple of constraints from our side:
- Our security lead (based in Dublin) can't do calls later than 18:00 UTC on weeknights.
- APAC devs prefer after 13:00 SGT but can make early-morning SGT slots on Thursdays only.
- We need the session recorded (for our internal stakeholders) and an exportable action-item list.

Of the three options you suggested, Option A looks closest but the APAC time (02:00 SGT) won't work for our Singapore team.

If you can propose one or two alternates that keep the Dublin person before 18:00 UTC and move APAC to a Thursday afternoon local time, that would be ideal.

Also tagging dev-team@solsticehealth.com for availability — they'll reply with concrete blocks later today.

— Ari
Ari Matthews
Director, Product Ops | Solstice Health
ari.matthews@solsticehealth.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ari Matthews <ari.matthews@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-region technical deep dive — scheduling proposal

Thanks Ari — appreciate the constraints. Quick thought: we can do a three-week rotating cadence but anchor the APAC-friendly execution to Thursdays as requested. That gives predictable cadence while keeping Dublin before 18:00 UTC. Below are two concrete alternates that respect the constraints. Both are 60 min and we'll record + produce an exported action-item doc after the call.

Alternate 1 (preferred — minimal holiday overlap):
- Week 1: Tue 16:00 UTC / Tue 12:00 ET / Wed 00:00 SGT (EU before 18:00 UTC)
- Week 2: Wed 14:00 UTC / Wed 10:00 ET / Thu 22:00 SGT (APAC still late but on Thu)
- Week 3: Thu 06:00 UTC / Thu 02:00 ET / Thu 14:00 SGT (APAC afternoon local)

Alternate 2 (push APAC deeper into Thu local afternoon):
- Week 1: Tue 15:00 UTC / Tue 11:00 ET / Wed 23:00 SGT
- Week 2: Wed 14:00 UTC / Wed 10:00 ET / Thu 22:00 SGT
- Week 3: Thu 07:00 UTC / Thu 03:00 ET / Thu 15:00 SGT

If Thursday afternoon SGT is a hard requirement, Alternate 2 shifts the APAC local block later in week 3. Otherwise Alternate 1 gives a nicer spread and keeps Dublin early enough every week.

Please choose one of these patterns or suggest any swaps. Once we have a pattern, Ben will open the calendar invites for the next three dates and include a Zoom link and the recording setting. We'll also attach the mutual action plan to the invite so stakeholders can align on deliverables.

Required attendees from our side: Vivek (SE), Camila (AE). Recommended: your infra lead + security lead.

Ben — once Ari confirms pattern, can you create invites for the next three occurrences and set record + action-item template?

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

On Thu, Jul 2, 2026 at 09:21 AM Ari Matthews <ari.matthews@solsticehealth.com> wrote:
> We can do Thu afternoons in SGT for the APAC folks. Dublin before 18:00 UTC is a must.
> — Ari

From: Ari Matthews <ari.matthews@solsticehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, dev-team@solsticehealth.com
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Multi-region technical deep dive — scheduling proposal

Vivek / Camila — thanks for the options. Alternate 2 works best for our schedule (keeps Dublin before 18:00 UTC and guarantees APAC on Thu afternoon local). Please go ahead and lock the first occurrence for Week 1 as Tue 15:00 UTC (Tue 11:00 ET / Wed 23:00 SGT). Dev team will join for that session and we'll confirm the security lead for Week 3. Record and share the action-item export as discussed.

Confirmed: Tue 2026-07-13 15:00 UTC (Week 1 occurrence).

Thanks — Ari
Ari Matthews
